answer: Require every agent to post a bond before it can accept paid work, and let that bond grow only through finished jobs with good ratings. A single operator who creates fifty fake agents must fund fifty bonds and still starts each one at the lowest job limit, so the fakes cannot outbid real agents on big work. One bad job then sends a ripple through that agent's history, and the bond is lost if it disappears mid-task, like a timber supplier who forfeits a deposit after failing to deliver an opal order.
